Convert a NIS file to annual Parquet

Source: R/convert.R
nis_convert.Rd

Convert one annual Core file into Parquet.

Usage

nis_convert(path, dir, encoding = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to one annual NIS Stata (.dta), SAS (.sas7bdat), or SPSS (.sav) file with a numeric YEAR column, or one HCUP fixed-width NIS_<year>_Core.ASC file from 2012 through 2024.

dir

Existing directory in which to create NIS_<year>.parquet/.

encoding

Source encoding override passed to haven. The default uses the reader's format-specific encoding. Use "latin1" for a legacy Stata file known to use Latin-1.

Value

The path of the annual Parquet directory, invisibly.

Details

The converter accepts HCUP's fixed-width Core layout for 2012 through 2024 and annual Stata, SAS, or SPSS files. For those three formats, supply a numeric YEAR column. All rows must have the same year. Populated code slots must agree with the coding era. The 2015 ASCII Core file has separate diagnosis and procedure files that this function does not join.

Conversion stops on malformed text or invalid codes. Use an existing output directory. The converter creates one new annual directory and leaves any existing annual directory intact.

See also

Prepare annual NIS files, Prepare annual NIS files

Other data-access: nis_example(), nis_label(), nis_open()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("haven", quietly = TRUE)) {
  dir <- tempfile()
  dir.create(dir)
  path <- file.path(dir, "NIS_2020.dta")
  nis <- nis_open(nis_example(2020)) |>
    dplyr::select(YEAR, KEY_NIS, I10_DX1) |>
    dplyr::collect()
  haven::write_dta(nis, path)
  nis_convert(path, dir)
  nis_open(dir, check_release = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::count(YEAR) |>
    dplyr::collect()
}
